package repository

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
)

type transactionScopeKey struct{}

// TransactionScope stores work that must run only after the outermost
// database transaction commits successfully.
type TransactionScope struct {
	mu          sync.Mutex
	afterCommit []func()
}

// WithTransactionScope attaches a fresh outer transaction scope to ctx.
func WithTransactionScope(ctx context.Context) (context.Context, *TransactionScope) {
	scope := &TransactionScope{}
	return context.WithValue(ctx, transactionScopeKey{}, scope), scope
}

// DeferAfterCommit queues fn when ctx belongs to an open outer transaction.
// It returns false when the caller should execute fn immediately.
func DeferAfterCommit(ctx context.Context, fn func()) bool {
	scope, ok := ctx.Value(transactionScopeKey{}).(*TransactionScope)
	if !ok || scope == nil {
		return false
	}
	scope.mu.Lock()
	scope.afterCommit = append(scope.afterCommit, fn)
	scope.mu.Unlock()
	return true
}

// RunAfterCommit executes queued work after the database commit succeeds.
func (s *TransactionScope) RunAfterCommit() {
	if s == nil {
		return
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	callbacks := append([]func(){}, s.afterCommit...)
	s.afterCommit = nil
	s.mu.Unlock()
	for _, callback := range callbacks {
		callback()
	}
}
